purpose: Findings listed here are intentionally visible in SEC-2 evidence and are not supply-chain allowlist suppressions.

findings.remove_when: Remove this visible finding policy once aws-cdk-lib publishes a bundle with brace-expansion >= 5.0.6.
findings.justification: aws-cdk-lib@2.257.0 is still the latest npm package and bundles brace-expansion@5.0.5 through minimatch@10.2.5. npm audit fix reports that the bundled dependency cannot be fixed automatically and must be fixed by an aws-cdk-lib update.
